diagnosis: The pure-IBD simulator computes sqrt((scaled geographic distance)^2). On one near-tied real geometry this floating round trip changes weak edge ordering. The rank residualizer then correctly treats the changed ordering as nonzero and rank01 magnifies the tiny ordering perturbation. The failure is therefore in numerical construction of the exact-IBD calibration arm, not evidence that endpoint-safe IBD residualization generally fails.
permitted_repair: For the exactly noise-free, zero-residual-amplitude IBD-only calibration arm, construct genetic distance directly as positive_scale_times_geographic_distance, without the square/square-root round trip. Do not introduce an empirical residual threshold.
